top_signals.title: Small UK power generator shut down after cyberattack linked to Iran: Telegraph
top_signals.summary: The U.K. government says the incident did not pose a risk to the country's energy system, adding that it briefed CEOs of companies in the sector with advice.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
